title: Building – Installation of two glazed openings in an exposed buildingface – December 2016
description: A home builder installed two glazed windows in an exposing building face, at a limiting distance where no unprotected openings were permitted. It fitted 22-gauge steel fire shutters on the exterior and used a fire-retardant-coated wood sheathing product (Protektor board) instead of 12.7 mm exterior gypsum under vinyl siding.

refusal.basis: analogous: appeal of an s.49 order, not a variance refusal. The panel's reasoning turns on missing evidence for the proposed alternative solutions.

outcome_summary: Order varied. Interior-mounted fire shutters may be an acceptable alternative, and Protektor board may be considered if evidence is provided against the criteria in the Government of Alberta's 1 Feb 2012 Notice.
